# Security built for how enterprises actually operate

Third-party apps and AI agents are where your business runs. We make sure they're not where it breaks.

Obsidian Security Secures Agentic Access in 3P Apps with $85M Series-D led by Crescent Cove Advisors

![](https://fast.wistia.net/embed/medias/zk2evg4zxf/swatch)

## Why we exist

### **The perimeter**  **is gone.**

Your data doesn't live behind a firewall. It lives in Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow and 35K+ third-party enterprise apps you don't own, and on infrastructure you don't run.

### **A new identity is in**  **control.**

Service accounts, API tokens, AI agents. Non-human identities now outnumber people inside your enterprise application estate, and most security teams can't see them.

### **The trust model is**  **broken.**

The attack surface isn't at the edge. It's in the trust and access model, and inside the apps where your most sensitive data and workflows actually live.

### **Security teams are flying blind.**

Logs are buried in individual apps. Threats are invisible until it’s too late. And there's no single place to see what's happening across the SaaS and AI estate.

## Our mission

## Make AI adoption unstoppable

by bringing trust and control across every

third-party application agents touch.

Security teams have been handed an impossible brief: defend actions by identities they can barely enumerate, across apps they didn't build, on infrastructure they don't control.

We give our customers the visibility into what's connected, controls to enforce what's allowed, and clarity on what needs to change.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a70bb37265293d9a748c7cc_Platform%20Graphic%20(1).svg)

## Why now and why Obsidian

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a44111fba0e7f6851350d0d_why-osidian-visual.jpg)

## AI is accelerating your risk exposure. We close the gap before it becomes catastrophic.

Every AI application and agent connected to your enterprise inherits the permissions and trust misconfigurations that already existed in enterprise applications.

At Obsidian, we spent years mapping every identity, permission, and data flow across the third-party enterprise application estate. That foundation is what protects enterprises in the AI era.

[Learn more](https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/ai-security)

## How we got here

2021

### Security for SaaS

Identity and SaaS apps were the new attack surface. Nobody was watching them. We committed to solving it.

2022

### First set of F500 customers

Security teams at large financial services and technology companies adopted Obsidian to detect account takeovers, SaaS threats and privilege misuse.

2023

### Series C —   $90M raised

Backed by IVP, Norwest, and GV. Expanded to cover SaaS integrations. Launched threat detection across the full SaaS estate.

2024

### Third Party Supply Chain Security

As third party apps started connecting to each other, we pioneered securing NHI access across them, guarding a layer that was left exposed.

2025

### AI Security launched

As enterprises connected AI tools and agents to sensitive data, we built the visibility layer to detect risks before they became breaches.

2026

### AI Agent Security Foundation

As AI agents began inheriting access across third party apps, we built the first system to map their real permissions and block high risk actions at runtime.

### Series D – $85M raised

Led by Crescent Cove Advisors, and backed by all existing investors to scale trust across every third-party app agents touch.
